articles.abstract_en: Financial benchmarks such as LIBOR underpin the pricing of trillions of dollars of contracts around the world. We evaluate the quality of benchmark prices using a state-space model to separate information from noise. Applying the method to LIBOR benchmarks and their replacements, we find that alternative reference rates (ARRs) are less noisy in four of the five currencies. However, the USD ARR is considerably more noisy, resulting in billions of dollars of noise-related wealth transfers between contract counterparties. We show that benchmark reforms such as expanding the reference market and using a trimmed mean can reduce noise in ARRs.
articles.abstract_cn: 金融基准如LIBOR支撑着全球数万亿美元合约的定价。我们使用状态空间模型将信息与噪声分离，以评估基准价格的质量。将该方法应用于LIBOR基准及其替代品，我们发现替代参考利率（ARRs）在五种货币中的四种中噪声较小。然而，美元ARR的噪声显著更大，导致合约对手方之间数十亿美元的噪声相关财富转移。我们表明，扩大参考市场和使用修剪均值等基准改革可以减少ARRs中的噪声。

articles.title_en: Main Street’s Pain, Wall Street’s Gain
articles.abstract_en: We propose a fiscal policy expectations mechanism. When bad macro news arrives (in our study, when initial jobless claims (IJC) are higher than expected), investors may expect more generous government spending and drive up aggregate stock prices through the expected cash flow channel. Using a time-series sample from January 2013 to March 2021, we find that this phenomenon emerges when newspapers mention fiscal policy more. In the cross section, firms expected to receive more government spending – through stimulus supports during COVID-19 or procurement contracts before 2020 – exhibit higher individual stock returns when bad IJC shocks arrive.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种财政政策预期机制。当不利的宏观新闻到来时（在我们的研究中，即当首次申请失业救济人数（IJC）高于预期时），投资者可能预期政府支出将更加慷慨，并通过预期现金流渠道推高整体股价。利用从2013年一月至2021年三月的时间序列样本，我们发现当报纸更多地提及财政政策时，这一现象会出现。在横截面上，预期获得更多政府支出的公司——无论是通过COVID-19期间的刺激支持还是2020年前的采购合同——在不利的IJC冲击到来时，表现出更高的个股回报。

articles.title_en: Can everyone tap into the housing piggy bank? Racial disparities in access to home equity
articles.title_cn: 每个人都可以使用住房存钱罐吗？获得房屋净值方面的种族差异
articles.abstract_en: We document large racial disparities in the ability of homeowners to access their accumulated housing wealth. Minority homeowners are significantly more likely to have their mortgage equity withdrawal (MEW) product applications rejected than White homeowners, and the unconditional disparities are significantly larger than those found in prior studies that focused on purchase and rate/term refinance loans. Had Black homeowners faced the same MEW denial rate as White homeowners in our sample period we show they would have extracted an additional $11.2 billion in housing equity, or almost 25% of the total amount of actual equity extracted. Controlling for key underwriting variables significantly narrows the racial disparities, with the Black–White gap falling by nearly 85%, and the Hispanic-White gap falling by more than 75%. Credit scores and debt-to-income ratios are the most important factors explaining the gaps, while differences in loan-to-value ratios contribute only modestly. “Residual” disparities after conditioning on observable underwriting factors are large and vary significantly across lenders. A battery of tests suggests that differences in unobserved underwriting factors are unlikely to fully explain the residual disparities, which tend to be larger in geographic areas characterized by more racial animus.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了房主获取其积累的住房财富的能力存在巨大的种族差异。与白人房主相比，少数族裔房主的抵押贷款权益提款（MEW）产品申请被拒绝的可能性要大得多，而且无条件差异明显大于之前专注于购买和利率/定期再融资贷款的研究中发现的差异。如果黑人房主在我们的样本期内面临与白人房主相同的 MEW 拒绝率，我们表明他们将额外提取 11.2 十亿美元的住房净值，或几乎 25% 实际提取的净值总额。控制关键承保变量显着缩小了种族差异，黑人与白人之间的差距下降了近 85%，西班牙裔与白人之间的差距下降了超过 75%。信用评分和债务与收入比率是解释差距的最重要因素，而贷款与价值比率的差异则贡献不大。以可观察的承保因素为条件后的“剩余”差异很大，并且不同贷方之间差异很大。一系列测试表明，未观察到的承保因素的差异不太可能完全解释剩余的差异，在种族敌意较多的地理区域，这种差异往往更大。

articles.title_en: Investor demand, firm investment, and capital misallocation
articles.title_cn: 投资者需求、企业投资与资本错配
articles.abstract_en: Fluctuations in investor demand significantly affect firms’ valuation and access to capital. To quantify their real effects, we develop a dynamic investment model, incorporating both the demand and supply sides of capital. Strong investor demand relaxes financial constraints and facilitates equity issuance and investment, while weak demand encourages opportunistic share repurchases, crowding out investment. We estimate the model using indirect inference, matching the endogenous relationship between investor demand and firm policies. Our estimation reveals that demand fluctuations are important drivers of firm-level investment and economy-wide capital misallocation, accounting for 26.9% of dispersion in MPK and 23.4% of productivity losses.
articles.abstract_cn: 投资者需求的波动显著影响企业的估值和资本获取能力。为量化其实际影响，我们构建了一个动态投资模型，同时纳入资本的供需双方。强劲的投资者需求放松了融资约束，促进了股票发行和投资，而疲弱的需求则鼓励机会主义的股票回购，挤出投资。我们使用间接推断法估计模型，匹配投资者需求与企业政策之间的内生关系。我们的估计显示，需求波动是企业层面投资和整个经济资本错配的重要驱动因素，分别解释了MPK离散度的26.9%和生产率损失的23.4%。

articles.title_en: Fintech entry, lending market competition, and welfare
articles.title_cn: 金融科技进入、贷款市场竞争与福利
articles.abstract_en: We provide a spatial framework to study competition between banks and fintechs in the lending market and examine the impact on investment and welfare. Based on the key differences between banks and fintechs, we derive results consistent with the empirical evidence available. We find that fintechs with inferior monitoring efficiency can successfully enter because of their superior flexibility in pricing and that higher bank concentration leads to higher fintech loan volume. If fintechs and banks have similar funding costs, fintech borrowers pay lower loan rates and have higher default rates than bank borrowers with similar characteristics; however, the result will flip if fintechs have much higher funding costs than banks. The advantage of fintechs in offering convenience can also induce them to charge higher loan rates than banks. Fintech entry will improve welfare if fintechs have high monitoring efficiency and inter-fintech competition intensity is intermediate. Fintech entry may induce banks’ exit and reduce investment; however, it will increase investment if inter-fintech competition is intense enough.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个空间框架来研究银行与金融科技在贷款市场上的竞争，并考察其对投资和福利的影响。基于银行与金融科技之间的关键差异，我们得出了与现有实证证据一致的结果。我们发现，监控效率较低的金融科技因其在定价上的更高灵活性而能够成功进入市场，且银行集中度越高，金融科技贷款量越大。如果金融科技与银行的融资成本相似，那么具有相似特征的借款人中，金融科技借款人的贷款利率更低，但违约率更高；然而，如果金融科技的融资成本远高于银行，这一结果将发生逆转。金融科技在提供便利性方面的优势也可能使其收取高于银行的贷款利率。当金融科技具有高监控效率且金融科技间竞争强度处于中等水平时，金融科技的进入将改善福利。金融科技的进入可能导致银行退出并减少投资；然而，如果金融科技间的竞争足够激烈，则会增加投资。

articles.abstract_en: We demonstrate that off-exchange (wholesaler) executions provide significant cost savings to retail investors. Wholesaler concentration has raised regulatory concerns; however, we show that the largest wholesalers offer the lowest costs due to economies of scale. The entry of a new large wholesaler reduces incumbent scale economies, resulting in higher execution costs. Most retail brokers route to multiple wholesalers and actively monitor their performance, rewarding those offering lower execution costs with more volume. While retail investors benefit from the current landscape across all stocks, those trading small stocks benefit the most.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们证明，场外（批发商）执行为散户投资者带来了显著的成本节约。批发商的集中引发了监管担忧；然而，我们表明，由于规模经济，最大的批发商提供最低的成本。新的大型批发商的进入减少了现有批发商的规模经济，导致执行成本上升。大多数零售经纪商将订单路由至多个批发商，并积极监控其表现，将更多交易量奖励给提供较低执行成本的批发商。尽管散户投资者在当前格局下从所有股票中受益，但交易小盘股的投资者受益最多。

articles.title_en: Understanding the strength of the dollar
articles.abstract_en: We attribute variation in the strength of the U.S. dollar and its covariance with other currencies to economic primitives using a global asset demand system. We take global investor savings, asset supply, and monetary policy as exogenous primitives, and show how these variables explain dollar exchange rate behavior. Prior to the global financial crisis, global savings and demand shifts explain dollar depreciation, whereas post-crisis they explain dollar appreciation. Interest rates and cross-border bank loans explain short-term fluctuations in the dollar, but decline in significance over longer horizons. When explaining the dollar factor structure, we find that global savings explain common variations across dollar exchange rates, whereas investor demand shifts account for cross-sectional heterogeneity in dollar betas.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用全球资产需求系统，将美元强势的变化及其与其他货币的协方差归因于经济原始要素。我们将全球投资者储蓄、资产供给和货币政策视为外生原始要素，并展示这些变量如何解释美元汇率行为。在全球金融危机之前，全球储蓄和需求变动解释了美元贬值，而危机后它们则解释了美元升值。利率和跨境银行贷款解释了美元的短期波动，但在较长时期内其显著性下降。在解释美元因子结构时，我们发现全球储蓄解释了美元汇率间的共同变动，而投资者需求变动则解释了美元贝塔值的横截面异质性。

articles.title_en: Strategic digitization in currency and payment competition
articles.title_cn: 货币与支付竞争中的战略性数字化
articles.abstract_en: We model the competition between digital forms of fiat money and private digital money. Countries digitize their currencies–by upgrading existing or launching new payment systems (including CBDCs)–to compete with foreign fiat currencies and private digital money. A pecking order emerges: less dominant currencies digitize earlier, reflecting a first-mover advantage; dominant currencies delay digitization until they face competition; the weakest currencies forgo digitization. However, delayed digitization allows private digital money to gain widespread adoption, eventually weakening fiat money’s role. We highlight how geopolitical considerations, stablecoins, and interoperability between fiat and private digital money shape the dynamics of currency competition.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们模拟了法定货币的数字形式与私人数字货币之间的竞争。各国通过升级现有支付系统或推出新支付系统（包括央行数字货币）来实现货币数字化，以与外国法定货币和私人数字货币竞争。一种层级秩序应运而生：较不占主导地位的货币更早实现数字化，反映了先发优势；占主导地位的货币则推迟数字化，直到面临竞争；最弱的货币则放弃数字化。然而，推迟数字化使私人数字货币得以广泛采用，最终削弱法定货币的作用。我们强调了地缘政治考量、稳定币以及法定货币与私人数字货币之间的互操作性如何塑造货币竞争的动态。

articles.title_en: Reaching for yield: Evidence from households
articles.title_cn: 追逐收益：来自家庭的证据
articles.abstract_en: The literature has documented “reaching for yield”—the phenomenon of investing more in risky assets when interest rates drop—among institutional investors. We analyze detailed transaction data from a large brokerage firm to provide direct field evidence that individual investors also exhibit this behavior. Consistent with models of portfolio choice with labor income, reaching for yield is more pronounced among younger and less-wealthy individuals. Consistent with prospect theory, reaching for yield is more pronounced when investors are trading at a loss. Finally, we observe and discuss the phenomenon of “reverse reaching for yield.”
articles.abstract_cn: 文献记录了机构投资者在利率下降时增加对风险资产投资的“追逐收益”现象。我们分析了一家大型经纪公司的详细交易数据，提供了个人投资者也表现出这种行为的直接实地证据。与包含劳动收入的资产组合选择模型一致，追逐收益在年轻且财富较少的个体中更为显著。与前景理论一致，当投资者亏损交易时，追逐收益更为明显。最后，我们观察并讨论了“反向追逐收益”的现象。

articles.title_en: Central bank liquidity reallocation and bank lending: Evidence from the tiering system
articles.title_cn: 中央银行流动性再配置与银行贷款：来自分层准备金制度的证据
articles.abstract_en: We document that the reallocation of central bank reserves towards banks with higher liquidity needs fosters credit supply. Exploiting the ECB's tiered reserve remuneration system for identification, we show that this system encouraged banks with low reserve holdings to obtain more reserves through the money market. Concomitantly, these banks reduced their securities holdings and extended more credit. We estimate that the reallocation of one euro of reserves towards banks with ex ante low reserve holdings resulted in an increase in credit supply of about 15 cents.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了中央银行准备金向流动性需求较高的银行再配置会促进信贷供给。利用欧洲中央银行的分层准备金报酬制度进行识别，我们表明该制度鼓励准备金持有量较低的银行通过货币市场获取更多准备金。与此同时，这些银行减少了证券持有并增加了信贷发放。我们估计，将一欧元准备金向事前准备金持有量较低的银行再配置，会导致信贷供给增加约15欧分。
